decision_question: Is Omnizart a sufficiently well-defined, production-eligible OSS challenger to justify running it against the failed dense/full-mixture domain of production auto -> Basic Pitch?

baseline.current_consequence: Keep Basic Pitch as the operational auto baseline, but do not describe dense/full-mixture performance-note transcription as solved.

implicit_default_is_not_general_music.evidence: omnizart/defaults/music.yaml sets General.TranscriptionMode to Piano. BaseTranscription._load_model(None) resolves that default checkpoint.
implicit_default_is_not_general_music.consequence: Do not evaluate plain `omnizart music transcribe` as the general-music challenger; it answers a piano question already owned by the solo-piano route.

stream_mode.published_reference_result: 66.59% note-streaming score on the MusicNet test set, per Omnizart paper.md
stream_mode.domain_fit: WEAK_FOR_TARGET. The target failure is dense/general full mixtures; Stream is explicitly MusicNet/classical-instrument shaped. It remains a possible research probe, not a well-matched production candidate by provenance alone.

pop_mode.domain_fit: STRONGER_THAN_STREAM. Upstream describes the Pop dataset as pop music with various instruments, drums and vocal.

training_data_provenance.finding: The v0.6.3 PopStructure explicitly names its training-audio root `01_ytd_audio`; no production-safe dataset/license grant for those training recordings was found in the inspected Omnizart repository/docs.

pop_mode.consequence: Do not substitute the Pop checkpoint merely because it matches the target domain better. Its training-data provenance is a harder production gate than Stream's domain mismatch.

license_provenance_gate.repository_license: Top-level MIT license grants rights in the Software as distributed by the repository.
license_provenance_gate.checkpoint_distribution: Learned TensorFlow variables for music_note_stream are fetched from a separate GitHub release asset by `omnizart download-checkpoints`.
license_provenance_gate.related_upstream_signal: Upstream issue #115, opened 2026-08-01 for the bundled drum checkpoint, asks the maintainers to clarify whether MIT expressly covers checkpoint files and commercial inference/redistribution; it remains open with no maintainer response at this evaluation date.
license_provenance_gate.finding: Under ListenCloser's dependency/evaluation policy, do not infer a production weight grant from the code license when the separately distributed model asset has no explicit terms. Model-weight commercial-use/redistribution status is unresolved.

runtime_gate.reason_not_measured: The production-candidate validity gate failed before inference. Adding/installing the TensorFlow-heavy candidate solely to obtain a score would not change the current production decision.

quality_run.reason: Candidate validity failed before the same-input benchmark stage. The evaluation methodology requires license/provenance validity before spending work on a promotion-bearing run.

decision.dense_full_mix: KEEP_ABSTAIN_QUALIFY. Preserve the known failure domain; do not present performance-note transcription for dense/full mixtures as reliable general-music understanding.
decision.omnizart: Do not add an Omnizart production adapter, dependency, route or worker integration from current evidence.
why: The implicit default is a piano checkpoint and would make the proposed comparison invalid.
The explicit Stream checkpoint is MusicNet/classical-domain shaped rather than target-domain shaped.
The more target-shaped Pop checkpoint points at YouTube-derived training audio with unresolved production provenance.
The separately distributed learned variables do not have explicit weight/commercial-redistribution terms in the inspected release/docs, so the production license gate fails closed.

revisit_only_if: Omnizart maintainers or another authoritative source explicitly establish commercial inference and redistribution rights for the exact candidate checkpoint variables, with sufficient model/training-data provenance for ListenCloser's deployment.
A materially different production-eligible general-music AMT candidate appears with a clearer dense-mixture domain fit, explicit weight rights and CPU-feasible deployment path.
